targets.query: select sum(vusers) from (SELECT max("currentActiveThreads") as vusers FROM "virtualUsers" WHERE time > ${__from}ms and time > now() - 20s GROUP BY "nodeName" fill(none)) fill(none)
targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  SUM(max_threads_per_location) AS "Total"
FROM (
  SELECT
    node_name,
    MAX(active_threads) AS max_threads_per_location
  FROM virtual_users
  WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' AND test_environment = '$test_environment' AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name) AND 
        $__timeFilter(time) AND
        time > now() - interval '20 seconds'
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY 1
) sub

SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (to_timestamp($__to/1000) - to_timestamp($__from/1000))) AS total_seconds;

SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,
  SUM(max_threads_per_node) AS "Total"
FROM (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time,
    node_name,
    MAX(active_threads) AS max_threads_per_node
  FROM virtual_users
  WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' AND test_environment = '$test_environment' AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name) 
        AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1,2
  ORDER BY 1,2
) sub
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS time,
  sum(bytes_in) as "Bytes In",
  sum(bytes_out) as "Bytes Out",
 (sum(bytes_in) + sum(bytes_out)) / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '$__interval'::INTERVAL) as "Total Traffic"
FROM requests_raw_${cagg_suffix}
WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' AND test_environment = '$test_environment' AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name) AND $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS time,
  sum(n)::float / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '$__interval'::INTERVAL) as "Requests per second",
  sum(avg_rt * n) / NULLIF(sum(n), 0) as "Response times",
  sum(avg_connect * n) / NULLIF(sum(n), 0) as "TCP Connect"
FROM requests_raw_${cagg_suffix}
WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' AND test_environment = '$test_environment' AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name) AND $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT

WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' AND test_environment = '$test_environment' AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name) AND $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2;

SELECT

  min(min_rt) AS min_response_time,
  ROUND(sum(avg_rt * n) / NULLIF(sum(n), 0)) AS avg_all,
  ROUND(sum(sum_rt_ok)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(n_ok), 0)) AS avg_ok,
  max(max_rt) AS max_response_time,
  ROUND(approx_percentile(0.90, rollup(pct_agg))::numeric) AS p90,
  ROUND(approx_percentile(0.95, rollup(pct_agg))::numeric) AS p95,
  ROUND(approx_percentile(0.99, rollup(pct_agg))::numeric) AS p99,
  sum(n) AS total,
  sum(n_ok) AS passed,
  sum(n_err) AS failed,
  ROUND(sum(n_err)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(n), 0), 4) AS error_percentage
FROM transactions_${cagg_suffix}
WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' AND test_environment = '$test_environment' AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name) AND
      $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
